resources.string: A personal encrypted self-hosted note-taking app.
The app is encrypted with this password. It cannot be recovered.
This device has no secure hardware, so only this password protects your notes.
Erase all notes and start over?
Without the password these notes cannot be recovered. Erasing deletes every note on this device and returns to setup.
Unlock with a fingerprint or face instead of the password. Adding a new fingerprint or face turns this off.
Enter your password to turn on biometric unlock.
Use a fingerprint or face to unlock Native Note instead of typing the password.
Biometric unlock was not set up. Try again, or choose Not now.
Keep your notes on your own Native Note server, end-to-end encrypted.
This device keeps its notes and stops syncing them. The server keeps its copy.

Enter this library\'s server and its API key, also after the server moved or its key was replaced. An empty server takes the library under new recovery words; one that holds another library is refused.
These words are used to encrypt your notes on your sync server. Keep them safe and never share with anyone.
Enter words %s from the phrase you wrote down.
This server already holds a library. Enter its current 24-word recovery phrase, and this device syncs with it.
The recovery phrase was changed on another device. Enter its current 24 words to continue.
Make sure your screen isn\'t watched
Word %d is not in the recovery word list.
These words are not a recovery phrase. Check for a mistyped or swapped word.
Enter the server\'s address, starting with http:// or https://.
Enter the 64-character API key from the server\'s api-key file.
This server now holds a library. Enter its recovery phrase to sync this device with it.
This server holds another library. Native Note cannot merge two libraries; choose a server that holds this one, or an empty one.
This server no longer holds a library. Continue to start a new one.
Sync is already set up on this device.
Sync is not set up on this device.
The recovery phrase was changed on another device, so this phrase was not saved. Enter the current phrase to continue.
The server holds an older recovery phrase than this device last saw. It may have been restored from a backup.
The server\'s answer did not arrive, so this phrase may already be in effect. Keep it, and any phrase it replaces, and try again.
Those words don\'t match the phrase. Check what you wrote down.
This phrase does not open the library on this server.
Save every note as a markdown file in one zip.
Add the notes from a Native Note export that are not here yet.
The export holds every note as a markdown file. Without a passphrase, anyone with the file can read them.
Enter the passphrase the export was made with.
Wrong passphrase, or the export is damaged.
